headline.confidence: A clear idea so far. Who calls the API and how it signs in are still open.

items.title: How tasks are paged
items.body: A team can have thousands of tasks. How should the list endpoint hand them back?

options.detail: Stable while tasks are added and removed. No jumping to page 7.
Familiar and easy to link to, but rows shift when tasks change mid-scroll.
Simplest to build; slow and heavy once a team has a few thousand tasks.

items.fallbackText: How tasks are paged: a) cursor paging  b) page numbers  c) everything at once. My guess: a.
